description: This file defines schemas and utility functions for channel configuration using the Zod validation library, including functions to build nested schemas, clone issues, and validate runtime data.

methods.name: cloneRuntimeIssue
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a runtime issue object, filtering the path to include only string or number segments.

methods.name: safeParseRuntimeSchema
methods.description: Safely parses a value against a Zod schema, returning success status and data or issues.
